APPROVE
`Files` drops to roughly 4 and each helper stays well under 15, behaviour is preserved (the `maxFiles` break still falls through to subdirectory enqueueing, and a failed listing still records only the directory), and the CHA0004 suppression now covers every moved `catch`; I reviewed only the diff, so the build is unconfirmed, and it relies on `wanted` really being a `Func<string, bool>`, the `files` element type matching, and the C# 12 `[]` collection expressions compiling.
